direction.content_form: Daylight documentary invitation: a worn T-shirt, its remade pouch and a simple exchange share one tabletop; one full practical column makes the visit actionable.
direction.whole_expression_style: Close adult lifestyle photography, candid cotton/skin contact and a short confident editorial heading. A modest useful exchange, with unequal image/type responsibilities.

dimensions.expression: Direct photographic clothing contact is the expressive event.
dimensions.image_crop: Carry the broad garment crop and readable grip, but move to a stable table and omit faces.
dimensions.color: Quiet daylight neutrals give hands, knit and one garment accent priority.
dimensions.layout: An off-centre image mass meets flat type without an ornamental frame.
dimensions.information_grouping: Event identification and the complete practical column have separate responsibilities.
dimensions.type_roles: Bold flat heading identifies; firm smaller sans gives instructions.
dimensions.material: Cotton folds, seams, skin and one daylight shadow direction, without fake print finish.
dimensions.emotion: Everyday adult gesture makes a first visit feel possible.

reference_transfer.intentional_non_transfer: No face-covering pose, fashion rail, vertical GOOD device, source wording, source garment or copied letter arrangement.

layout.large_relationship: 422 px-wide photographic field at left; 298 px-wide light utility field at right. Identification occupies the quiet upper image field; garment/exchange occupies its lower half. The right column is substantial, not a miniature footer.
layout.alignment: Left type starts x24; practical type x446. Heading and date begin near y24, but the heading has greater typographic mass. Boundary x422 stops busy cloth before the facts.

visible_reading_route.evidence_scope: Trace of proposed 720×405 geometry and literal strings, supported by local font metrics. No rendered poster, viewer retrieval task or generated object correspondence has been observed.

typography.system: Flat bold Korean grotesk, medium English, regular to semibold factual sans.
typography.dominant_role: 36 px name; 26 px date opens the practical column.
typography.wrap_logic: Title, activity and all facts fit on one line in their reserved fields.
typography.punctuation: Keep 14:00–16:30 intact, including its en dash; retain all centred dots and comma.

image.scene_action_relation_crop: Photographic field [0,0,422,405], substantive action [0,174,422,231]. A recognisable flat adult T-shirt at lower-left; its finished pouch rests on the table while one adult hand steadies a side seam and a recipient hand supports/approaches the opposite base edge. A second finished pouch sits behind it. Only these two action hands; wrists crop at separate field edges. Keep collar, one sleeve junction, selected torso panel and main pouch mouth visible. No floating cloth or busy sewing operation.

necessary_features: The usable T-shirt body panel has two unequal-width horizontal knit bands and a short offset interruption in the lower band.
The exchanged pouch front preserves band order and that interruption in the corresponding panel region; new side seams and a visible mouth distinguish it from folded cloth.
Each wrist belongs to a separate adult; one hand steadies the side, the other receives/supports the base above the stable table.
intentional_changes: Only the selected torso panel is reused; collar and sleeves disappear.
Bands can truncate at new seams and change apparent scale with perspective, while order/interruption remain identifiable.
transformation.relationship_limit: Source/result correspondence and sharing are shown; this is not a complete sewing tutorial or a simultaneous physical transformation of the intact garment.

direction.material: Photographic jersey cotton with modest wear, seam edges, skin and matte pale tabletop under consistent soft side daylight. Clear text grounds; invocation does not imply tape.

color.background: Warm near-white daylight, pale grey table.
color.image: Muted slate cotton, restrained rust bands, natural skin.
color.role: The accent locates source/result fabric; value contrast carries title and facts.

nearest_direction_stripped_comparison.comparison: With colour/material removed, M1 keeps one full-height left scene and one continuous right information column, plus a one-line upper-left name. M4 keeps opposed corner vignettes, a compact two-line name and a central-to-lower-right factual step. M1 makes close object contact the evidence; M4 makes the shared adult table the whole spatial context.

common_constraints: Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.

T-shirt-to-pouch upcycling and sharing completed pouches must be visibly connected, with an approachable adult daytime hobby-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720.

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
